<p>Sooooooo…what’d y’all do this weekend?...It was kind of quiet. Not much on television. Did some yard work. Caught up on some reading (heavy sigh)…not the sports page. (Insert your favorite overcoming adversity quote here…but it doesn’t help much yet.) </p><p>So, <em>this</em> is what it feels like to be a <em>regular</em> college football fan? How and why do people do it? The pressure, the despair, the insecurity about whether your team will be successful or not? Diminished to just <em>hoping</em> your team will win instead of <em>knowing </em>they will win when they walk on the field?! Who knew Alabama’s foes had to endure such hardship? I have new respect for them all now. Being a college football is not for the weak of heart. </p><p>My poor Lola has been like this all week since the Alabama Aggie game.</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," height="240" width="348"></p><p>She has not yet experienced an Alabama football loss in her lifetime.
